title: Power Apps: refreshed row summary layout and Microsoft-provided summaries on view pages
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing requirements and three configuration paths are supported. One minor correction should acknowledge that the FAQ and maker guide describe related-record link limitations differently.

claims.claim: Row summaries rely on AI Builder to execute summary prompts.
claims.quote: Row summaries rely on AI Builder to execute summary prompts.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: AI Builder features in Power Apps consume AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: In Power Apps and Power Automate, AI Builder features consume either AI Builder credits (Licensing and AI Builder credits), or Copilot Credits (Licensing and Copilot Credits).

claims.claim: Running AI Builder prompts in apps consumes these credits.
claims.quote: Building custom and testing models (including prompts) doesn't require AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits. Running them in agents, agent flows, apps, or flows consume these credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; cost; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A mixed licensing model and variable cost reflect the documented user licences plus AI Builder credit consumption.
claims.quote: AI Builder is licensed on a capacity basis. Building custom and testing models (including prompts) doesn't require AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits. Running them in agents, agent flows, apps, or flows consume these credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a credit rate specific to row summaries.
claims.quote: Searched: row summaries credit rate licensing AI Builder; "row summaries" "credit" "rate". Read row summaries user, maker and FAQ pages and AI Builder Overview of licensing: prompt rates exist, but no row-summary-specific rate or model mapping was found.

claims.claim: The row summaries environment control is in Power Platform admin center at Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary > Row summaries > environment > Edit setting.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Copilot, and then select Settings. Under Power Apps, locate Row summaries in the Summary section. Select the environment, and then select Edit setting.

claims.claim: No operation that configures the Row summaries environment setting is documented for API or automation use.
claims.quote: Searched: row summaries Power Platform API pac admin; EnableFormInsights PowerShell API; powerApps_EnableFormInsights PATCH. Read pac admin, PowerShell support, row-summary admin control and SDK property reference; found a property, not an operation documented to set this control.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Row summaries environment setting controls row summaries on both main forms and view pages.
claims.quote: This setting controls row summaries on both model-driven app main forms and view pages.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: AI insight cards is the same environment-level capability as Row summaries in the Copilot settings experience.
claims.quote: The AI insight cards setting on this page and Row summaries in Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary control the same capability.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the AI insight cards location will be removed in a future release.
claims.quote: Use the Copilot settings experience as the preferred location. The AI insight cards location will be removed in a future release.

claims.claim: The legacy control is at Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > AI insight cards > Display AI-generated row summaries on records in model-driven apps in Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: select Manage. ... select Environments. ... select an environment. ... select Settings. Expand Product, and then select Features. ... AI insight cards ... Display AI-generated row summaries on records in model-driven apps.

claims.claim: No operation that configures the legacy AI insight cards setting is documented for API or automation use.
claims.quote: Searched: AI insight cards Set-AdminPowerAppEnvironment; EnableFormInsights Set-; PowerAppsEnableFormInsights Update. Read feature settings, PowerShell support, pac admin and SDK property reference; no documented operation tying the property to this setting was found.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Scope: Roles; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Updating the legacy feature settings requires the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions.
claims.quote: Ensure you have the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.

claims.claim: The maker control is in Power Apps at Tables > table > Customizations > Row summary > Show row summary.
claims.quote: In Power Apps, select Tables on the left navigation pane, and open the table with the configured row summary. Under Customizations, select Row summary. In the prompt configuration screen, use the Show row summary toggle

claims.claim: No documented API operation sets the table's Show row summary control.
claims.quote: Searched: row summary Show row summary API aiskillconfig table; AI Skill Config Web API; aiskillconfig entity reference; AI Skill Config Show row summary API. Read maker guide and AI Skill Config search excerpts; no operation and property for this toggle were found.

claims.claim: Show row summary hides the table's custom summaries configured through the row summary experience.
claims.quote: Turning off Show row summary hides the configured summary from all main forms and view pages for the table.

claims.claim: Show row summary does not hide summaries provided by Microsoft.
claims.quote: The Show row summary toggle affects only custom row summaries configured from this row summary experience. It doesn't hide summaries provided by Microsoft or summaries configured through another application or experience

claims.claim: The case summary is provided through Customer Service.
claims.quote: Case: Customer Service summary

claims.claim: Lead and opportunity summaries are provided through Sales.
claims.quote: Lead and opportunity: Sales summary features.

claims.claim: Row summaries are AI-generated overviews of record information in model-driven apps.
claims.quote: The Row summary feature in apps provides you with a concise, AI-generated overview of key details about a record.

claims.claim: The maker guide currently describes out-of-the-box Case, Lead and Opportunity summaries as available on main forms, not views.

claims.claim: Custom row summaries appear in the Insights bar on main forms.
claims.quote: Forms: When viewing a record in a main form, the summary appears in the insights bar at the top of the main form.

claims.claim: Users access a summary from a view through the inline Summary action next to a record.
claims.quote: Views: When browsing records in a view, select the inline Summary action next to a record to open the summary in a modal popup.

claims.claim: The view-page Summary action opens the summary in a modal popup.
claims.quote: select the inline Summary action next to a record to open the summary in a modal popup.

claims.fix: Replace 'no links to related records' with 'related-record link limitations'. Add: 'The FAQ says row summaries cannot include related-record links, while the maker guide says those hyperlinks might not render as expected.' The maker guide is https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/data-platform/configure-form-row-summary#known-limitations and is already cited.

claims.claim: Microsoft's FAQ advises treating a summary as a starting point.
claims.quote: Treat the row summary as a helpful starting point for understanding a record. Review the record's fields and related data directly before making important decisions based on that data.

claims.claim: Licence enforcement rolls out gradually following general availability.

claims.claim: Row summary usage might be subject to service limits or throttling.

claims.claim: No separate licence specific to the refreshed layout is published.

claims.claim: No separate charge specific to the refreshed layout is published.
claims.quote: Searched: row summaries separate licence charge; row summaries credit rate licensing AI Builder. Read row-summary user, maker and FAQ pages and AI Builder Overview of licensing; no separate refreshed-layout charge was found.

claims.claim: Displaying custom row summaries requires the environment setting and a configured table summary.
claims.quote: The AI insight cards environment setting that enables row summaries is on by default. Makers still need to configure and turn on summary prompts on individual tables so that row summaries appear on the corresponding forms and views.

claims.claim: A Power Platform administrator enables the Row summaries environment setting.
claims.quote: A Power Platform administrator must enable Row summaries for the environment in the Power Platform admin center

claims.claim: Makers configure custom row summaries per table in Power Apps.
claims.quote: Sign in to Power Apps (make.powerapps.com) select Tables on the left navigation pane, and then open the table where you want to configure a row summary.

claims.where: Scope: Out of scope for custom summaries
claims.claim: Custom row summaries in this experience are not available for Case, Lead and Opportunity tables because those tables provide their own Dynamics 365 summaries.
claims.quote: Some Dynamics 365 apps tables, such as Case, Lead, and Opportunity, provide their own summaries via the Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Sales applications. To avoid conflicts, the row summary feature isn't available for these tables.
